gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curves generous and its small letters nearly as high as the capitals, so it feels approachable. Noto Sans Oriya sits under Revalia's loose, widely spaced display letters like a steady hand under a loud voice.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Revalia strides along with widely separated letters and a lowercase g whose lower curve stays open. Noto Sans Osmanya follows with easy-turning s shapes and a lowercase that looms large next to its capitals, which makes paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau feels clean and modern, with curves left open at the ends. Revalia brings the bold, expressive swagger up top, and the sans below gives its loud letters somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Modern and contemporary in spirit, Noto Sans Phoenician opens its s curves wide at both ends and gives lowercase generous height. And Revalia, bold and expressive above it, loosens the whole page with its relaxed, widely separated stride.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-runic: Revalia is built for big, short lines, where its open-curled g and loose stride get room to show off. Noto Sans Runic backs it with a large x-height, little space above the lowercase, and curves that never close back on themselves.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Revalia leads with a bold, expressive voice, its lowercase g left open and its letters spaced far apart. But Noto Sans Sunuwar answers with curves that leave daylight, and short stems on lowercase bodies that feel clean and approachable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri has short ascenders, a large x-height, and an a whose lower bowl opens up to breathe. Revalia is the one for bold, expressive display work, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri does its best with quiet, clean text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac has lowercase bowls as round as blown glass bulbs, plus s shapes that turn wide and easy. Noto Sans Syriac then reads smoothly under Revalia's bold heading, with an approachable, modern feel.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Neutral and contemporary, Noto Sans Tai Tham packs its lowercase up toward the capital line and keeps the inside of the c clearly visible. And Revalia, bold and expressive with its open-bottomed g, supplies the loud heading while the sans-serif body stays out of its way.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet pairs short ascenders with a large x-height, and its terminals pull back from where the curves would close. So Revalia can be bold and loosely spaced up top while the sans-serif body stays professional and approachable below.
